scope: Read-only source/package audit for Firefox software codecs and T736 decoder bring-up on Linux 6.18; no board mutation or VE acceptance

board_observation.renderer_conclusion: Library mappings alone do not establish the active WebRender compositor; isolated about:support probe prepared
board_observation.renderer_probe_live_validation: Original 35-second baseline and EGL/GLES startup attempts both timed out with empty logs; this establishes no renderer result. Schema 2 extends startup to 120 seconds and captures process state, page faults, I/O and MMC diskstats

software_codec_packages.dependency_resolution: Let apt install the matching libavutil59, libswresample5 and other declared dependencies; do not copy only one shared library
software_codec_packages.expected_scope: Provides FFmpeg software codec support, including the missing Firefox H.264/AAC library path; runtime codec support still needs measurement
software_codec_packages.libva_note: apt may pull libva dependencies, but their presence is not a working T736 VAAPI driver

donor.license: Kernel donor GPL-2.0-or-later; packaged userland includes proprietary codec libraries
donor.interface: Private character device and ioctl ABI, not V4L2 or VAAPI

userspace_version_selection.selection_evidence: debian/mk-custome-rootfs.sh explicitly labels the 2.0.0 package for A733/T736; its libMemAdapter/libvdecoder RPATHs contain out/t736/demo_aiot

rejected_unverified_alternative.reason: Its package changelog mentions A537/A333 and its library RPATHs contain out/a537/demo_aiot; a higher filename version is not evidence of A733 compatibility

allocator.note: CdcIon function names do not imply an old /dev/ion dependency; this packaged library uses dma-heap. Confirm memory type selection, heap availability, cache synchronization and contiguous IOVA mapping before decode

userspace_version_selection.inspection_method: dpkg-deb extraction into build/cedar-package-audit; readelf and strings only; no vendor binary execution or system installation

decoder_donor_dt.encoder_excluded_from_initial_scope: ve2 at 0x01c10000, IRQ 48, VE_ENC power domain

linux_6_18_port_requirements.finding: Current work tree has dedicated T736 USB, GMAC, GPU and display clock/power providers, but no complete VE clock/reset/power, T736 IOMMU or NSI path
linux_6_18_port_requirements.required_work: Implement and validate decoder PLL/gates/reset, VE_DEC power sequencing and DMA/IOMMU/NSI routing before enabling the decoder DT node

linux_6_18_port_requirements.finding: Donor sunxi_cedar_remove at cedar_ve.c:2165 returns int; Linux 6.18 include/linux/platform_device.h:233 requires void
linux_6_18_port_requirements.required_work: Update the removal signature and all return paths; audit probe failure and runtime-PM cleanup

linux_6_18_port_requirements.finding: Donor cedar_ve.c:2358 uses MODULE_IMPORT_NS(DMA_BUF); Linux 6.18 module.h passes its argument directly to MODULE_INFO
Donor already has >=6.6 class_create and dma_buf_*_attachment_unlocked paths and >=6.1.25 vm_flags_set
linux_6_18_port_requirements.required_work: Keep the applicable modern paths; do not introduce obsolete compatibility shims

linux_6_18_port_requirements.finding: user_iommu_param.iommu_addr and dma_buf_param.phy_addr are 32-bit; map_dma_buf_addr currently takes the first sg_dma_address and narrows it without checking mapped contiguity or 32-bit range
linux_6_18_port_requirements.required_work: Enforce a suitable DMA mask, a valid contiguous IOVA covering the buffer, overflow checks, balanced attach/map/unmap/detach and cache synchronization; never treat the first scatterlist address as a whole-buffer mapping without proof

linux_6_18_port_requirements.finding: cedardev_mmap maps from the VE register base using the requested length without an explicit register-resource length bound
linux_6_18_port_requirements.required_work: Bound the mapping to the intended register resource and audit private ioctl copies, lengths, lifetime and per-file cleanup before exposing the device to non-root applications

linux_6_18_port_requirements.finding: Driver includes sunxi-log/sunxi-sid, platform-specific DVFS and optional AMP/rpmsg IOMMU hooks; flush_cache is an assembly source
linux_6_18_port_requirements.required_work: Isolate the sun60iw2 decoder path, replace logging dependencies, audit DVFS/regulator policy and cache code; keep unrelated AMP/rpmsg, kernel codec and encoder paths outside the first port

acceptance_sequence: Complete isolated Firefox baseline versus EGL/GLES about:support measurement without disabling sandbox or overriding graphics blocklists
Install the minimal software codec package and repeat runtime codec-support and playback measurements
Build the isolated sun60iw2 decoder port against Linux 6.18 with audited providers and private ABI; this source audit is not a successful build
Verify clocks/reset/power, device version, dma-buf/IOMMU mapping and recovery before submitting compressed video
Decode a known short H.264 sample to memory/YUV with the matching Cedar 2.0 family and compare output to software decode; then test supported H.265/VP9 separately
Design and validate a browser-supported integration separately; Firefox does not consume Cedar/OpenMAX private libraries directly
